summary: This note is a short biographical entry on John Middleton Clayton, an American lawyer and politician from Delaware who lived from 1796 to 1856. It states that he was a Whig Party member who served in the Delaware General Assembly, as a U.S. Senator from Delaware, and as U.S. Secretary of State. The note gives only these basic identifying facts and career roles.
one_line: John Middleton Clayton was a Delaware lawyer and Whig politician who served in the state assembly, the U.S. Senate, and as U.S. Secretary of State.
key_facts: John Middleton Clayton was born on July 24, 1796.
John Middleton Clayton died on November 9, 1856.
John Middleton Clayton was an American lawyer and politician from Delaware.
John Middleton Clayton was a member of the Whig Party.
John Middleton Clayton served in the Delaware General Assembly.
John Middleton Clayton served as U.S. Senator from Delaware.
John Middleton Clayton served as U.S. Secretary of State.
